title: cancel() does not run the cancelled task's cleanup inside the call; awaiting it observes the cleanup done
purpose: Run the program and observe the order of its output.

stdout.text:
main: before cancel
main: after cancel; done: false
worker: cleanup
main: settled -1; cancelled: true

provenance.origin: authored for #340; Sparrow (Tomato) is the reference behaviour
provenance.expected_basis: #340 with structured await (#147): the cleanup runs when main suspends at await; the settlement is observed after it.
